Each entry: name, ring (0=London .. 4=Canada-wide), platform (ATS type the fetcher knows), slug/tenant/site (ATS identifiers), careers_url (human page; also the thing to inspect when platform is 'resolve'), flags. platform='resolve' means the ATS is not yet identified -- the fetcher skips it and lists it under 'to resolve' so it can be filled in ONCE, after which it fetches free forever.
